notes.title: YOUNG SOULS FREE DEMO IS NOW LIVE TILL OCT 7!
notes.content:
Greetings cool folks,


The Young Souls demo is now available for FREE until October 7 and we highly encourage you to play this gem. Jenn, Tristan, and a whole army of goblins are waiting for you in the basement for a unique experience, in which you will get deeply attached not only to the universe but also to all its protagonists. This demo will make your weekend and the week ahead much more special!

Also, please note that Remote Play Together is available with this demo. Beat up goblins on your own, or in co-op, the choice is all yours. 

 DISCLAIMER: Young Souls demo contains flashing lights and patterns that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. If you or anyone in your family has an epileptic condition, consult your doctor before playing this beta. If you experience any of the following symptoms while playing Young Souls demo: dizziness, blurred vision, eye or muscle twitches, loss of consciousness, disorientation, involuntary movements or seizures - stop playing IMMEDIATELY and consult your doctor before resuming play. 

Please note that the Young Souls demo is still a WIP, as a result, you may encounter a few known issues that the development team is already investigating and working on. If you encounter any issues, feel free to post a message on the Steam forum!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/7b691a850c6c45a69e2b31b6c7d9f23e1a923efa.gif

Here's what you can expect from this demo:

The Young Souls demo is split into two parts: "The Beginning" and "Exploring Dungeons". We invite you to start playing this demo with "The Beginning", which gives you a quick overview of the gameplay and the story, and then jump into action with " Exploring Dungeons". Naturally, the choice is entirely up to you! After all, you couldn't please Jenn and Tristan more than by not playing by the rules. 

💜 The Beginning

In this part, you will dive into the colorful world of Young Souls and discover the touching complicity between our two twins in the early stages of their quest. Explore the city, talk to the locals, experience the combat system, and go on an inspiring quest for adventure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/c8d031021a9bc6f34b745455ce2ab976ad7c0eea.gif

⚔️ Exploring Dungeons

Young Souls has an incredible atmosphere, both in the city and in the dungeons. In this part of the demo, it's time for you to pick up your weapons and get to know the threats that await you. Explore the dungeons, fight and beat up goblins, all with your own fighting style, and armor. 

This demo is just a preview of the quest that awaits you in Q4 2021, but don't worry, the whole game is coming soon! We hope you will enjoy this preview as much as we love this title.

With all our love and all our heart, we wish you the best experience with this demo and a great weekend! We are looking forward to your feedback on the forums or even on our social media. Thank you for your patience, the wait is almost over now, so stay tuned!

Greetings everyone, 

The team is thrilled to unveil a bit more about Young Souls gameplay with this new trailer:

[previewyoutube=FzOIvxelOec;full][/previewyoutube]

Gear up and let's rock! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/3139984e23f1d8cd00ccb0efe78b61a798ca6094.gif

In Young Souls, our protagonists, Jenn and Tristan, gotta travel to Goblins Market to meet the Blacksmith who will forge them weapons and armor sets to go on the battlefield. 
 
There are hundreds of weapons (including dual-wielding swords, knives, and some unlockable weapons), armor sets (shields, helmets...), and accessories (bombs, grappling...) to fight hordes of belligerent goblins in the dangerous dungeons you're about to explore. 

Your equipment got its own stats as a result, you can customize your characters to match or create your own playstyle. 


Fight to survive

You will travel through Goblins World and complete a dozen dungeons set in four biomes to save the professor. Hordes of belligerent goblins and savage bosses will come on your way to challenge you on the battleground but you know what? You gonna love it.

notes.title: Young Souls - Learn more about Young Souls story and gameplay!
notes.content:
We are 1P2P Studio (developers) and The Arcade Crew (publisher) and today we'd like to introduce you to our indie game called Young Souls.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/b4b3a219a7f275078c3fa46e35fac5b92f1af4c9.png

What is Young Souls?

Young Souls is a beat'em up RPG (playable solo or in local coop) set between two worlds, Human and Goblins'. 

Orphaned from a young age, Jenn and Tristan's path crossed with a loving scientist, The Professor, who took them in and treated them as his own children. But one day, he suddenly disappears in mysterious circumstances.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/ffe966ad5e424b5d8d505be68dec2d2f268fbef3.png

Jenn and Tristan looked for him everywhere. When they rummaged his office, they found a hidden cellar with a huge portal called "Moon Gate" that teleported them to a parallel world where Goblins live.

EXPLORE GOBLINS' WORLD AND GRAB SOME EQUIPMENTS:

A long journey awaits and you better get ready for it. Equip yourself, unlock hundreds of weapons (one/two-handed swords), armor sets (shields, helmets...), and accessories (bombs, grappling...) to fight hordes of belligerent goblins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/3139984e23f1d8cd00ccb0efe78b61a798ca6094.gif

You gotta travel through Goblins Realm and complete a dozen dungeons to save the Professor and Human's World which is threatened by an upcoming war. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/894fff0b53115e1c4d86e71881470a0764724825.gif

GET BACK TO THE SURFACE TO UPGRADE YOUR STATS: 

Sleep. Yes, you read it right. In Young Souls, you have to sleep to retrieve energy from intense fights but also level up while having sweet dreams.

Ready to feel that burn? When the day rises, wake up, get dress, and grab your "Happy Fit" token to hit the gym. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38973478/22941a212a7010a77dd938c758ce661b454088b3.png

Improve your strength, resistance, and stamina by attending cardio, abs, and exercise bench sessions. When the pain is over. Head to Solid Sneakers and get yourself the best kicks in town that will give you style and boost your characters' stats on the battleground.

SOME COOL STUFFS ABOUT YOUNG SOULS: 

- That game is fully loaded with action and it makes the scenario exciting 
- Allied goblins who give the best of themselves to help you as much as possible 
- Enemy goblins who give the best of themselves to defeat you (without success if you're strong enough)
- The dungeons and those boss fights will challenge you and you gonna love it 
- Those surprise enemy assaults will bring more excitement to your quests 

Make sure to wishlist Young Souls on Steam and stay tuned for future updates on the game!
